snippet.title: Deckzin - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Deckzin is available on Steam! Wishlist now!
Steam link in the comments! o/

Deckzin is a dungeon crawler deckbuilder with roguelike and RPG elements. Play as fantastic heroes, build and refine legendary decks, adapt to encounters and events in fast-paced runs, defeat powerful bosses, and keep the world’s last light alive.
